sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/363 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place for PlaceId 363, search/grid for facilities 510 'Sites 1-118' and 511 'Sites 119-256', search/details for all 251 web-listed campsites on 2027-06-15, plus sites 001 and 150 on 2027-06-19 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Electric sites $41 a night, full hookups $56, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (Nov 1-Apr 30) every open site is $37, full-hookup sites without water at the site. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all 251 Maumee Bay campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric Rate 41.00, Campsite Full Hookup 56.00, Fee 6.50); site 001 (full hookup) and 150 (electric) on Sat 2027-06-19 (56.00 / 41.00) and 2027-01-12 (37.00 / 37.00); https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/maumee-bay-state-park-campground ('Full hook-up sites do not have water at the site; fees are reduced accordingly'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '20/30/50' on all 251 sites; Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup on the 20 full-hookup sites) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/maumee-bay-state-park-campground ('electric and full-hookup sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 256 campsites (ReserveOhio's park description); 251 are listed online: 231 electric and 20 full hookup, all back-in asphalt pads 50 ft x 11 ft. Sites are open and border meadows; pets on designated sites only.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/place ('There are 256 campsites at Maumee Bay State Park') + search/details (PullInTypeName 'Back In', Maximum Camping Unit Length 50, Pad Size "50' L X 11' W") + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/maumee-bay-state-park-campground ('Sites are open and spacious and border natural meadows', 'Pets are permitted on designated sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Heated shower houses; off-peak (Nov 1-Apr 30) the shower houses close and two heated family restrooms with showers stay open, with potable water at the dump station. Campground ponds are for registered campers only.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/maumee-bay-state-park-campground ('Shower houses (heated) and flush toilets'; 'Off-peak Season: From November 1 to April 30, showerhouses are closed; two family restrooms are heated and include shower facilities ... Potable water is available at the dump station'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak season November 1 to April 30: only campsites 145-178 stay open, with reduced facilities.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/maumee-bay-state-park ('Maumee Bay State Park Campground is open year-round') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/maumee-bay-state-park-campground ('Campsites 145 through 178 remain open'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations required, up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727; every listed site is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/maumee-bay-state-park ('Reservations are required and can be made six months in advance, online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking, MaxStay 14, check-in/out times), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees confirmed ($41 electric base, +$15 full hookup, $37 off-peak, $6.50 res fee). Added 50-amp electric with water/sewer at the 20 full-hookup sites, 256 back-in sites to 50 ft, heated showers/flush toilets/water/dump, year-round season with the sites 145-178 winter loop, ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, 14-night max. AWH note kept verbatim.
